description: Leave an INTERNAL NOTE on an Intercom conversation: only the brand's teammates see it, never the customer (a summary, a suggested reply, a handover). Without confirm:true it adds nothing and returns the preview; call again with confirm:true once the user agrees. Read back from the conversation. Free. Needs Intercom connected (Connectors > Intercom, or connect_connector).

confirm.description: true once the user agreed to add this note

note.description: the note text teammates will read

name: add_intercom_note
title: Add an internal Intercom note
